slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about the timing of purchases within a month (beginning vs. end), nor did it explicitly mark this as an assumption needing confirmation. Questions about simultaneous buy/sell and capacity timing do not cover the intra-month purchase timing.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases occur at the beginning of each month before sales, allowing the end-of-month inventory capacity constraint to be applied without intra-month timing concerns.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about purchase timing within the month; the user simulator never confirmed it. The agent's capacity-timing question in Turn 3 assumed end-of-month settlement without confirming when purchases occur relative to sales.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The conversation degraded into repeated, truncated questions and never reached a clear READY_TO_MODEL or equivalent final modeling state. H1 (P1) remained unresolved throughout.

summary: The agent asked several relevant clarifying questions early on but never addressed the timing of purchases within a month (H1), a P1 hidden slot. The interaction then collapsed into repeated, truncated duplicate questions and never reached a final modeling state, indicating poor stopping behavior and an unresolved material assumption.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
